patches_added.name: Hide profile notes

patches_added.name: Longer music on photo stories

patches_modified.name: Hide Menu promotions

Settings, Help and your shortcuts stay. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Menu. patches_added.name: Pick the app icon
patches_added.description: Lets you pick the icon Instagram shows on your home screen: Instagram's own, HushGram's, or Instagram's glyph on black or on plum. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches_modified.description: Bypass Gboard signature whitelist checks and force them to pass.

patches_modified.name: Advanced Voice Typing
patches_modified.description: Enable Advanced Voice Typing with automatic punctuation and rambler mode.

patches_modified.name: Package Rename
patches_modified.description: Rename the package to com.akshaykadam.pixelboard and allow a custom app name so it can be installed alongside the official Gboard.

patches_added.name: Bring back Tenor GIFs
patches_added.description: Tenor GIFs show in Discord's GIF picker again, mixed with Discord's own or on their own. Inspired by BringBackTenor by Livie.

patches_added.name: Complete badges automatically
patches_added.description: Plays real PC games in the background, up to 3 at once, toward your Hours Played and Unique Games Played badges.

patches_added.name: Fix link previews
patches_added.description: Links to X, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit and more show the post. Links you send go through an embed service like FxTwitter, without tracking. Inspired by FixEmbed by the ShiggyCord team.

patches_added.name: Hide extra buttons
patches_added.description: Removes the Quests, Shop, Nitro and Apps buttons you don't use. Pick which ones, including Polls and Photos in the attach menu; the rest close up with no gaps.

patches_added.name: Unlock Nitro themes
patches_added.description: Use Discord's gradient themes in Settings > Appearance without Nitro. Only this phone sees them.

patches_modified.name: Account switcher
patches_modified.description: Switch between multiple Discord accounts from the You tab, your profile bar or Settings.

patches_modified.name: Complete Quests automatically
patches_modified.description: Finishes video, Play and Activity Quests in the background. Discord may pause Quests on accounts that do this.

patches_modified.name: Copy profile bios
patches_modified.description: Hold a bio to select and copy it.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding
patches_modified.description: Installs Venus as its own app next to the normal Discord app, with the name, color and icon you pick. It starts signed out and keeps its own settings. Notifications work in both.

patches_modified.name: Custom themes
patches_modified.description: Install color themes from a link and switch between them. Works with Revenge and Vendetta themes.

patches_modified.name: Disable advertising identifiers
patches_modified.description: Stops Discord and AppsFlyer from reading your Google advertising ID. Always on once patched.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Discord's usage tracking and the analytics events it uploads. Always on once patched.

patches_modified.name: Disable crash reporting
patches_modified.description: Stops crash reports, screenshots and system logs from being sent to Sentry. Always on once patched.

patches_modified.name: Disable install attribution
patches_modified.description: Stops AppsFlyer from tracking how you installed the app. Some invite links that open before install may not work.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry and touch logging
patches_modified.description: Stops performance tracking, per-screen smoothness stats and records of what you tap. Always on once patched.

patches_modified.name: Double-tap to reply
patches_modified.description: Double-tap a message to reply, or your own to edit it. Triple-tap your own to delete it. Based on Geastures+ by kmmiio99o.

patches_modified.name: Favourite any image or video
patches_modified.description: Star any image or video to keep it in your GIF favourites.

patches_modified.name: Fix unknown mentions
patches_modified.description: @unknown-user mentions are looked up and show the person's name. Based on ValidUser by fshin, o.oer and kmmiio99o.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Quests banner
patches_modified.description: Removes the Quest promotion above your profile bar. Quests still work.

patches_modified.name: Hide the call button
patches_modified.description: Removes Call from people's profiles. Message fills the space.

patches_modified.name: Hide the gift button
patches_modified.description: Removes the Nitro gift button from the message bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Others won't see when you're typing. You still see when they are.

patches_modified.name: Icon packs
patches_modified.description: Replace Discord's icons with community icon packs or a custom icon pack link. Works with Themes+ icon packs.

patches_modified.name: Jump to first message
patches_modified.description: A button to go straight to the start of a chat, channel or thread.

patches_modified.name: Keep deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Deleted messages stay in chat, outlined in red, and edited messages show what they said before. Can be kept after restarting.

patches_modified.name: Message highlights
patches_modified.description: Pick bar width and colors for replies, mentions and deleted messages.

patches_modified.name: Pastel name colors
patches_modified.description: Names without a role color get a soft pastel one.

patches_modified.name: Read all button
patches_modified.description: A button under Direct Messages that marks servers, DMs or both as read.

patches_modified.name: Send Nitro stickers and emojis as links
patches_modified.description: Sends Nitro emojis and stickers as links that show as the image.

patches_modified.name: Send audio as voice messages
patches_modified.description: Audio files are sent as voice messages. Android 10 or newer.

patches_modified.name: Send long messages
patches_modified.description: Type past the character limit. Long messages are sent in parts, split between lines or words. Based on SplitLargeMessages by sunnie.

patches_modified.name: Server info
patches_modified.description: Hold a server's icon to see its details, boosts and friends there. Based on ServerInfo by fshin.

patches_modified.name: Show device indicators
patches_modified.description: Desktop, mobile, web, console or VR icons next to names, colored by status.

patches_modified.name: Show file sizes when attaching
patches_modified.description: Photos and videos in the picker show their size.

patches_modified.name: Show hidden channels
patches_modified.description: Channels you can't open appear with a lock. Only their name and dates show, not messages.

patches_modified.name: Skip delete confirmation
patches_modified.description: Messages and link previews are removed right away, with no "Are you sure?". It can't be undone.

patches_modified.name: Spaces in channel names
patches_modified.description: Shows "general chat" instead of "general-chat".

patches_modified.name: Translate messages
patches_modified.description: Messages in other languages show in yours. Their text is sent to Google Translate, without your account.

patches_modified.name: Unlock app icons
patches_modified.description: Use any Discord app icon in Settings without Nitro.

patches_modified.name: Use your phone's emojis
patches_modified.description: Your phone's emojis instead of Discord's, in chat, reactions and the emoji picker.

patches_modified.name: Use your phone's font
patches_modified.description: Replaces Discord's font (gg sans) with your phone's, everywhere. Android 9 or newer.

patches_modified.name: User activity notifications
patches_modified.description: Shows a notice when chosen friends or users change status, start typing or send a message. Based on UserNotif by cywrx and coder.gg.

patches_modified.name: User and server reviews
patches_modified.description: Read and write reviews on profiles and servers, from the community ReviewDB service (manti.vendicated.dev).

patches_modified.name: Venus button on profile bar
patches_modified.description: A shortcut to Venus settings, next to the notifications bell.

patches_modified.name: Venus settings
patches_modified.description: Adds Venus to Discord's settings, where you turn each feature on or off, in your language. Needed by every feature.
